title: ryania patrisii
intro: Ryania patrisii, commonly known as Ryania, is a plant species native to Central and South America, and is also known as poison tree due to its toxic properties. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including pain and inflammation, due to its health benefits such as analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and anti-cancer properties. The therapeutic actions of Ryania patrisii include its ability to reduce pain and inflammation, making it useful in the treatment of conditions like arthritis and other musculoskeletal disorders. The bioactive constituents of Ryania patrisii include sesquiterpenes, alkaloids, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
